title: Customer Churn Analytics Dashboard
description: Interactive Power BI dashboard analysing customer churn patterns across 7,043 telecom records. Tracks churn rate, retention, average tenure, and monthly charges — with dynamic slicers for contract type, internet service, payment method, and gender.

title: Netflix Content Analytics Dashboard
description: Power BI dashboard exploring 7,791 Netflix titles across 683 countries. Visualises content distribution by rating, genre, and director — with a world map of titles by country, Movies vs TV Shows breakdown, and dynamic slicers for year, country, rating, and category.

title: Debit Card Renewal Management System — Project Report
description: Comprehensive project report for a web-based debit card renewal platform, enriched with Business Analyst value additions. Covers requirements elicitation, stakeholder analysis, system workflows, and business justification for a PHP MVC-based card issuance system built as a university group project.

title: BookInn — ICT Project Report
description: Full project report for BookInn, a hotel booking and room management platform. Documents the system from an ICT and business perspective — covering project scope, functional requirements, system design, and operational workflows for a full-stack booking solution deployed on Vercel.

title: Customer Churn Predictor
description: The ML engine behind the churn analytics work — an end-to-end prediction model built on telecom data. Engineered features, benchmarked classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost), and surfaced key churn drivers via SHAP explainability to support data-driven retention decisions.

title: BookInn — Live System
description: The working implementation of the BookInn project report — a full-stack hotel booking platform with an admin dashboard for managing rooms, guest reservations, and booking status. Built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB, deployed live on Vercel.

title: Debit Card Online Issuer — Live System
description: The working implementation of the debit card project report — a web-based debit card issuance platform built with a custom PHP MVC architecture. Handles card application workflows, user management, and database-driven record tracking. Deployed and live.
